description: Estimates what a PPO dental plan should pay and what the patient owes for planned treatment, applying the deductible left, coverage percentage per category (preventive, basic, major), any blocked lines and the yearly maximum left, the way insurers do. Send plan numbers and fees only: there is no field for, and you must not send, a patient's name, birth date, member ID or any date. Unknown fields are refused.

annual_max_left.description: Yearly maximum still available, in US dollars; null or leave out when the plan has none.

coverage_percent.description: Percent the plan pays per category. Default preventive 100, basic 80, major 50.

deductible_left.description: Deductible still owed this plan year (default 0), in US dollars.

deductible_waived_for.description: Categories the deductible does not apply to. Default ["preventive"].

in_network.description: True when the office is in the plan's network (default true). In network the allowed fee is the PPO fee; out of network the patient also owes the gap to the office's price.

services.description: The planned treatment, one item per service.

allowed_fee.description: In network the PPO (contracted) fee; out of network the plan's usual fee. Default the office fee, in US dollars.

blocked.description: Set when the plan pays nothing for this line: not covered, a waiting period not over, a frequency limit reached, or the missing-tooth rule.

office_fee.description: The office's full price, in US dollars.

name: estimate_dental_cost
title: Dental cost estimate (PPO)
